selection.parameter_policy: declared archived configuration, verified against observed telemetry; no tuning by analysis

definitions.gates: unaltered per-case validation gates; all CTE RMS/p95 reproduced from independent trace
definitions.cruise_mask: elapsed>=5s and independent reference>=cruise-.1m/s; same as acceptance
definitions.cycling: descriptive true speed spread and recurring >=.25s deficit episodes >.5m/s below cruise; no causal transmission claim
definitions.gear: observed actor.get_control().gear before next command; control API field only
definitions.pairing: same v2 adapter, preset/lookahead, original reference and 6/8mps; straight6 max unpaired
definitions.gear_replicates: S vendor gear uses development-v2-speed-diagnostic/17563; metrics pair against original v2 matrix

limitations: One run per case; no uncertainty or leaderboard generalization.
PI includes a >.2s motion-gap guard absent from vendor mode.
Different exposure on failing/short traces can affect descriptive cycle counts.
Gear fields do not establish torque interruption or internal gear-shift causation.
